Registration.Subject: UPFCON Confirmation Email
Registration.Body:
Thank you for choosing UPFCON!


Hello {{user}},

We are delight to welcome you to UPFCON!

In order to access your profile, you must confirm your email by clicking on this link.

Once your account is confirmed, a validation process will commence where one of our admins will confirm your identity as well as the documents you've provided (diplomas.)

(If you've only registered as an attendee, the confirmation process does not concern you.)

Thank you again for choosing UPFCON!

Warm regards,

UPFCON team

EmailChange.Subject: Email Change Confirmation Email
EmailChange.Body:
Hello {{user}},


We've received a request for an email change.

In order for this change to take effect, you must confirm it by clicking on this link.

If you haven't made any requests, just ignore this email.

Warm regards,

UPFCON team
